description: Verso: Memorial prayer for the deceased (Yosef, Avraham) with blessings for the surviving mourners (Shela and his brother Menaḥem). Recto: Further memorial prayers for Shela ha-Levi; Shelomo; Yefet; Shela; and an unnamed woman. Written in the hand of a scribe who left many other fragments (see FGP join finder).
description_he: רשימה או טבלה בAramaic, Hebrew. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
